dialogue.realtalk: A heart-to-heart. Bold. Very well, %1$s — I'll fetch my heart, you keep the receipts.
dialogue.realtalk.checkin.good: Suspiciously well. The roof stopped leaking and nobody's borrowed my shovel. I'm braced for the correction.
dialogue.realtalk.checkin.rough: Oh, thriving — if thriving means the week and I have agreed to stop speaking. Thanks for asking, though. Genuinely.
dialogue.realtalk.day.good: The chickens obeyed, the bread cooperated, and nothing caught fire. Historians will want this documented.
dialogue.realtalk.day.rough: The bucket broke, then the fence, then my composure. In fairness, the bucket started it.
dialogue.realtalk.work.like: I like it the way one likes an old chair. It complains, I complain, and neither of us leaves.
dialogue.realtalk.work.hate: The work and I have an arrangement: it pays for bread, I refrain from public comment. Until now, apparently.
dialogue.realtalk.life.first: The unabridged version? Born, blundered, learned, repeat. Since it's you, %1$s, I'll include the good footnotes.
dialogue.realtalk.dreams.first: A chair by a window and nobody needing me before noon. I know. Wildly ambitious.
dialogue.realtalk.fears.first: Being the joke nobody remembers. There — something honest. Cherish it, it's not on the regular menu.
dialogue.realtalk.feelings.first: I've reviewed the evidence, %1$s, and it appears I like you. Don't let that get around.
dialogue.realtalk.deflect.personal: Nice try, %1$s. That answer costs more than one pleasant afternoon. Two, at minimum. Keep them coming.
dialogue.realtalk.deflect.intimate: Straight for the locked drawer, I see. The key is earned, not asked for — but you're asking the right questions.
dialogue.realtalk.gossip.none: The big story this week is the well bucket squeaking in a new key. We're all quite gripped.
dialogue.chat: Ah, dialogue. My second-favorite indoor sport. Serve when ready, %1$s.
